entry.title: The performance per dollar of AI chips purchased each quarter has grown by an average of 49% per year
entry.summary: Since 2023, the average dollar spent on AI chips each quarter has yielded about 49% more performance each year in constant 2025 dollars, doubling every 1.7 years as spending shifts to each new chip generation.

entry.title: Will financing bottleneck AI compute? An Anthropic case study
entry.summary: Why Anthropic's buildout suggests that financing is unlikely to be the immediate blocker to frontier AI compute growth.

entry.title: AI at work: how AI is changing everyday job tasks
entry.summary: One in five US workers say AI now does work they once handed to a coworker or contractor, per a new Epoch AI/Ipsos survey of 1,106 employed adults.

entry.title: Disclosed CVEs: July Reached 5× the Pre-Mythos Record
entry.summary: Notable organizations disclosed ~2,500 high- and critical-severity CVEs in July 2026, about 5× the pre-Mythos monthly record. Epoch AI's updated breakdown of vulnerability disclosures following Anthropic's Project Glasswing.

entry.title: Will parallelization limits delay an intelligence explosion?
entry.summary: Even with automated AI R&D producing millions of virtual researchers, progress may be capped by our ability to divide, coordinate, and recombine their work. Epoch AI on why parallelization technology is a missing parameter in intelligence explosion models.

entry.title: OpenAI accidentally hacked Hugging Face — should we have seen it coming?
entry.summary: Expert assessments and cyber benchmarks led us to expect that frontier models were capable of executing this kind of cyberattack

entry.title: AI detectors rarely flag human writing, but sometimes miss AI text imitating real authors
entry.summary: We tested Pangram, GPTZero, and Originality.ai on human and AI text. All three caught nearly every passage written from a simple prompt, but missed roughly one in five passages imitating a specific author's style.

entry.title: Topic Overview: AI Energy Use
entry.summary: AI compute draws tens of gigawatts globally—comparable to New York state—yet a single chatbot query uses less than a microwave in 10 seconds. Epoch AI's guide to AI energy use, from training to inference to local grid impacts.

entry.title: Contributions to OpenAI's Codex codebase show signs of AI uplift
entry.summary: The share of working days on which OpenAI's Codex collaborators merged very-high-effort code rose from about 2% in Q2 2025 to about 8% in Q2 2026.
